title: Normal Dice Distribution
description: Interactive simulation showing the distribution of single dice rolls approaching normal distribution
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: probability
dice
distribution
statistics
uniform distribution
learningObjectives: Explain why a single fair six-sided die follows a discrete uniform distribution with probability 1/6 for each face
Observe how the empirical histogram of roll counts converges toward the flat theoretical distribution as the number of rolls grows
Distinguish empirical (observed) frequencies from theoretical probabilities and explain why small samples show large deviations
Predict roughly how many of N rolls will land on a given face and compare the prediction with the simulated counts
